colors.palette_type: Dark Navy with Gold/Amber Accents, Teal Positives & Red Negatives

layout_and_navigation.desktop_sidebar: Fixed 260px left sidebar with dark navy background (#0B132B), gold border right (#1E2A4A), collapsable navigation sections for 12 pages.
layout_and_navigation.mobile_drawer: Slide-over drawer from left, controlled via top-bar hamburger icon, backdrop blur overlay (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md).
layout_and_navigation.top_bar: Fixed 60px header at z-40 with backdrop blur (bg-[#0B132B]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#1E2A4A]), containing App Title, IST Clock (JetBrains Mono live ticker), Manual/Auto Sync refresh button with spinning icon state, and Live API Connection status pill (CONNECTED / DISCONNECTED / DEGRADED).
layout_and_navigation.page_container: pt-[68px] pl-0 lg:pl-[260px] p-4 lg:p-6 min-h-screen bg-[#0B132B] text-slate-100

card_and_table_styles.card: bg-[#131C35] border border-[#1E2A4A] rounded-lg p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-lg shadow-black/30 hover:border-amber-500/30 transition-all duration-200
card_and_table_styles.table_header: bg-[#0F172A] text-slate-400 text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-[#1E2A4A] py-3 px-4 text-left
card_and_table_styles.table_row: border-b border-[#1E2A4A]/60 hover:bg-[#1A264A]/60 transition-colors text-sm text-slate-200
card_and_table_styles.data_density: Compact trading desk density: tight padding, high legibility, monospaced numerical data, distinct status chips.

key_components_guidelines.trade_decision_panel: Primary action card featuring large direction status (BUY / SELL / NO TRADE), overall signal confidence %, stop-loss & take-profit quick calculations, and Execution trigger button.
key_components_guidelines.btc_direction_panel: Bullish vs Bearish bias breakdown with multi-timeframe gauges (1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1D), momentum meters, and funding rate indicator.
key_components_guidelines.twelve_check_comparison_table: Matrix layout comparing 12 quantitative checks against Scalping vs Swing strategies with instant PASS/WAIT/BLOCKED status chips and expandable calculation details modal/accordion.
key_components_guidelines.five_pillar_cards: 5 distinct cards representing Macro, On-Chain, Technicals, Liquidation/Orderbook, and Sentiment pillars with status badges and score progress bars.
key_components_guidelines.price_chart: Recharts Candlestick/Area chart with volume bars, EMA crossovers, entry/stop target lines, and timeframe selector buttons (1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1D).
key_components_guidelines.news_radar: Real-time news ticker with sentiment tags (BULLISH, BEARISH, NEUTRAL), impact score, and countdown timers to key economic events (FED, CPI, NFP).
key_components_guidelines.login_screen: Sleek institutional command desk login screen with dark navy aesthetic, gold accent outline, password/pin input, system integrity check indicator, and mock login toggle.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_ratio: APCA high contrast for dark mode: bright text on dark navy, explicit hover states.
accessibility_and_testing.interactive_states: All buttons and links must have explicit hover, focus-visible ring (ring-2 ring-amber-500), and active state.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_convention: kebab-case data-testid on all interactive elements, e.g. data-testid='nav-btc-dashboard-button'
